frequency_question: How often do legislative principals with stated intent pass major omnibus reform bills within a given 24-month congressional session?
membership_rule: Includes major omnibus packages spanning multiple regulated industries (e.g., energy, infrastructure, tax) enacted into law; excludes minor single-agency authorizations and non-binding resolutions.
coverage_note: 6 named major omnibus attempts across recent decades; believed roughly 8-10 major comparable structural reform attempts total.
known_gaps: Excludes minor provisions folded unconditionally into must-pass appropriations bills.
skeleton: Major structural reform packages attempted under divided or narrow-majority Congresses across recent decades.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 6 documented major attempts = 66 percent baseline execution frequency.
validity_reason: Tied to the stability of congressional polarization dynamics and baseline legislative procedures across standard two-year terms.
